milestone.title: Action feedback toasts + number-key menu shortcuts

intent.outcome: Non-modal actions show a short-lived toast overlay that auto-dismisses and never blocks keyboard input.

problem.description: Feedback for lightweight actions (e.g. config saved) is modal or buried in screen-local messages. There is no shared transient toast. Number-key menu shortcuts are split out to a track item so this milestone stays a single chrome subsystem.

in_scope: App-level toast state (message + deadline) owned outside individual screens.
Render toast as a non-blocking overlay in ui::render chrome.
Auto-dismiss on tick/deadline in the App update path.
Wire at least config save (and optionally one other non-modal success) to show a toast.
Interaction/render tests for show + dismiss + input still handled.
out_of_scope: Replacing existing modal dialogs with toasts.
Toast stacking/queue (single toast only; newer replaces older).
Main Menu digit shortcuts (track item TW — separate).

acceptance_criteria.description: Toast appears for a wired non-modal action and auto-dismisses after the timeout
acceptance_criteria.evidence: M04 toast: AppContext toast + Clear overlay; config save wired; make lint ok; interaction 48 + render 33 + config_persistence 13 green.

acceptance_criteria.description: While a toast is visible, normal key handling still works (toast does not capture input)
acceptance_criteria.evidence: M04 toast: AppContext toast + Clear overlay; config save wired; make lint ok; interaction 48 + render 33 + config_persistence 13 green.

acceptance_criteria.description: Toast uses ThemeColors and renders without panic across themes
acceptance_criteria.evidence: M04 toast: AppContext toast + Clear overlay; config save wired; make lint ok; interaction 48 + render 33 + config_persistence 13 green.

design_decisions.choice: Single optional toast on App (or AppContext), rendered in ui::render overlay; newer toast replaces older; no queue
design_decisions.rationale: Matches out_of_scope stacking; one place for deadline tick; components call a small show_toast API.

design_decisions.choice: Store Instant deadline; App event/tick path clears toast when now >= deadline (no extra thread)
design_decisions.rationale: Fits existing poll loop; testable by injecting Instant or short timeout in tests.

work_packages.name: Toast subsystem
work_packages.goal: App-level auto-dismiss toast overlay wired to config save.
work_packages.rollback: Remove toast state, render, and wiring.

steps.action: Add App-level toast state (message + Instant deadline), render overlay in ui::render, dismiss when Instant::now >= deadline on App tick/update.
steps.done_when: Tests can show a toast and observe it gone after simulated time/tick.

steps.action: Wire config save success to push a toast (replace Settings-only message path or dual-write).
steps.done_when: Saving config surfaces a toast via App state; suite green.

steps.action: Theme/render coverage for toast overlay; confirm non-blocking input test remains green.

verification.evidence: M04 toast: AppContext toast + Clear overlay; config save wired; make lint ok; interaction 48 + render 33 + config_persistence 13 green.
